acceptance.note: P1/P3 are 'decided (schedule-candidate)': refutable per the stop-at-first-failed-premise rule. Amendment is required before downstream artifacts if any premise fails (DR-0010 Change control); a declared approximation exceeding the applicable T bound stops the schedule there.

consumer_rule: Consumers take the schedule constants only through torchsynth_voice.fixedpoint.schedule.require_accepted_schedule, which refuses unless this register declares dr_status 'Accepted' (the DR-0010 acceptance event above). Constants are emitted into tb/sv/gf180_rtl_constants_pkg.sv by the same refusal-gated tooling as the DR-0008 numeric constants; tools/generate_rtl_constants.py --check fails on any divergence.

budget_equation.form: C = C_counted + T;  N_clip = 352,800 x C
budget_equation.t_parameterization: T is the declared allowance for 2x exp2 + 1x tanh and is an elaboration-time parameter of the consuming lane (the #73/#74 transcendental approximation work, each verified against the frozen M1 bands and golden vectors); T is intentionally NOT a ratified constant

worked_example.source: DR-0010 (Accepted), Schedule feasibility table: 'N_clip at T=100 (C=245)' = 86.4 M cycles

refutable_bound.statement: T <= 138 at 25 MHz for <= 1x real-time; if the declared fixed exp2 and tanh approximations cannot be built within it, the premise fails and the schedule stops there — no downstream artifact may claim this budget
